name: Assume True Form
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 4, ranger 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a sprig of wolfsbane), DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Area 20-ft.-radius emanation from caster
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The spell works on all creatures with the shapeshifter subtype, or creatures using spells, supernatural, extraordinary or spell-like abilities to assume other shapes. Targets within the area of effect who fail their Fortitude save are forced into their natural form while they remain within the spell’s area of effect. Targets who fail their saving throw also suffer 1d4 hit points of damage per caster level (maximum 10d4) each time the spell effect causes them to assume their natural shape.
